text:
Type: hanging closet organizer
Use: storing shoes, folded clothes and accessories; inside a wardrobe in a bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary
Materials: canvas fabric, stitched edges, hook-and-loop hanging strap
Colors: cream beige, off-white trim
Shape: tall narrow column, ten open cubbies, soft collapsible sides, hangs from a rod by a top strap, lightweight, slim
Feel: neat, soft, practical
Goes with: white closets, light wood, neutral textiles; minimalist or Scandinavian bedrooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Hanging Closet Shelf - 10-Tier, Canvas
product.description: 10-tier hanging closet organizer shelf for clothing, linens, and more Creates instant shelf space in your closet Fastener attaches to any standard closet rod for easy installation; no assembly required Durable canvas construction that holds its structure well Wipe clean with cold water and a sponge
